cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the WordPress Developer role. With a solid foundation in web development and hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress sites, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme. I have developed custom page structures, implemented on-page SEO, and ensured responsive design across devices. My work involves collaborating with designers and marketers to turn concepts into functional, user-friendly websites, which aligns perfectly with your key responsibilities.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, a multi-page WordPress site I designed and built from scratch. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), optimized for speed and SEO, and ensured cross-browser compatibility. I also conducted iterative technical audits to improve the site's search health, demonstrating my problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

I am proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP, and I have experience with page builders like Elementor. I am familiar with website optimization, security best practices, and SEO fundamentals, and I continuously stay updated with WordPress trends. My background includes front-end development with AngularJS, which has strengthened my JavaScript skills.

I am a collaborative communicator, comfortable working in remote teams, and I am eager to grow within a supportive and creative environment. I am confident that my technical expertise and dedication to quality will make me a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your projects.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
